_meta.description: Single source of truth for policy numbers used by SolarAlign. Every entry must have value, unit, source_url, source_title, retrieved. Checked by scripts/check_sources.py via the policy-source-guard hook.

flat_incentive_rate_le_25kw_2026.source_title: Mass.gov — SMART 3.0 Program Details, Program Year 2026 Flat Incentive Rates
flat_incentive_rate_le_25kw_2026.notes: All-inclusive for systems <= 25 kW AC; not eligible for adders. Rate is locked for 20 years once qualified.

base_compensation_25_250kw_2026.source_title: Mass.gov — SMART 3.0 Program Details, Program Year 2026 Base Compensation Rates
base_compensation_25_250kw_2026.notes: For > 25 and <= 250 kW AC. Behind-the-meter incentive = (base + adders - value_of_energy) x kWh. Not an extra cash payment on top of bill savings.

base_compensation_250_500kw_2026.source_title: Mass.gov — SMART 3.0 Program Details, Program Year 2026 Base Compensation Rates
base_compensation_250_500kw_2026.notes: For > 250 and <= 500 kW AC. Rates above 500 kW not yet added: add from the same page before using.

compensation_term_years.notes: All SMART 3.0 projects have a 20-year compensation term.

value_of_energy.source_title: Mass.gov — SMART 3.0 Program Year 2026 BTM Value of Energy Workbook
value_of_energy.notes: TODO: derive from DOER's BTM Value of Energy and Incentive Calculator for the utility and rate class of the demo building. Until then, treat as a labeled assumption in the UI.

begin_construction_deadline.source_title: Solar Insure — Commercial solar tax credit deadline passed (summarizes OBBBA / Notice 2025-42)
begin_construction_deadline.notes: Projects beginning construction after this date must be placed in service by the date below. Replace with an irs.gov citation when available.

placed_in_service_deadline_if_late_start.source_title: Solar Insure — Commercial solar tax credit deadline passed
placed_in_service_deadline_if_late_start.notes: Eligibility also depends on other conditions (e.g., foreign entity rules). Output a status, never a guaranteed credit.

acp_rate.source_title: City of Boston — How to Comply with Your BERDO Emissions Standard
acp_rate.notes: Alternative Compliance Payment per metric ton CO2e above the building's limit. Reviewed by the BERDO Review Board at least every five years.

penalty_emissions_large.notes: Failure to meet emissions standards, buildings over 35,000 sq ft. Context only: model cost with ACP, not penalties. Replace with boston.gov citation when available.

penalty_emissions_small.notes: Failure to meet emissions standards, smaller covered buildings. Context only.

mid_size_nonres_compliance_start.source_title: Envigilance — BERDO 2.0 thresholds and compliance dates
mid_size_nonres_compliance_start.notes: Non-residential buildings 20,000–35,000 sq ft begin emissions compliance in 2030. Larger buildings began in 2025.
